technicalSummary: 12.1.1 fixes logger output/levels, enum values, circular dependencies, provider overrides and ParseArrayPipe numeric validation, plus microservice reconnect fixes.
Fixes environment interpolation property paths/prefix handling; updates dotenv to 18.0.3.
Adds decode overloads for complete option and nullable return.
Native ESM/root exports; deep dist imports removed; CommonJS require(esm) supported on Node 20.19+/22.12+.

Native ESM/root exports; legacy shims/deep imports removed; CommonJS require(esm) supported. PassportModule-only defaultStrategy/property options no longer forwarded to passport.authenticate; getAuthenticateOptions returns AuthGuardAuthenticateOptions.
Adds timer return type generics; deleted cron jobs are not resurrected after initialDelay.

Fixes literal enum/plugin/workspace imports, Standard Schema parameter handling, bundler Fastify static import and Swagger UI dollar escaping; optional TypeScript peer; HTTP QUERY support and dependency updates.
Preserves CommonJS entry exports in rspack/webpack; preserves parent links for aliased reexports.
Angular CLI dependencies updated; library without prefix supported; generated ESM Supertest type fix; CommonJS sub-app e2e execution fix.
Release page points to TypeScript 6 announcement and beta/RC/stable issue lists; compiler compatibility remains T3 verification.
Release page points to CHANGELOG.md; tagged 29.4.14 changelog reverts compiler-util changes.
